name: Berlin EmoDB 2.0: Database of Emotional Speech
description: Berlin EmoDB 2.0 is an expanded release of the Berlin Database of Emotional Speech. Featuring German utterances spoken by 10 professional actors simulating 7 emotions (anger, joy, sadness, fear, disgust, boredom, neutral), version 2.0 introduces electro-glottogram (EGG) measurements alongside 16 kHz audio and incorporates ambiguous utterances where human raters disagreed, providing a standardized testbed for aleatoric uncertainty and Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) in audformat.
